annotations.title: Check a domain's mail and DNS health (MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, certificate)

description: Mail and DNS health of a domain. Send a domain name; get six checks (MX records, SPF, DKIM selector hints, DMARC policy, TLS certificate expiry, public blocklists), each pass, fail or unknown with the record we saw and what to do, plus a signed, dated observation. Free, no sign-up, 100 checks a day per caller. Public DNS and one TLS handshake on port 443 only: no port scans, no mailbox probing, nothing stored. DKIM selectors cannot be listed, so a missing selector is unknown, never fail. Checks the domain you name, not who runs it.

dkim_selectors.description: Optional DKIM selector names you use (the part before ._domainkey). We also try 12 common ones.

domain.description: A domain name such as example.com. Not a URL, address or email.
